headline: Frank Gehry - Illuminations
context: Frank Gehry – Illuminations is a conference and workshop programme held in Istanbul as part of Architecture Week, organised by the Istanbul Association of Architects in Private Practice (İstanbulSMD) in memory of the late Frank Gehry.
